rationale: Artem's deep expertise in ML systems, computer vision, and real-time inference aligns well with Ruyi Dynamics' hardware-software integrated robotics platforms and AI deployment at scale. As an ML engineer who ships production systems, Artem could offer valuable technical perspective on embodied AI challenges, while Shan's work in robotics and autonomous systems represents a cutting-edge application domain for the kind of inference optimization Artem specializes in.
intro_message: Artem Yatsenko, meet Shan — both working at the intersection of production ML systems and embodied AI, from real-time inference on the engineering side to full-stack robotics deployment on the platform side.
